name: Spot

abilityDetails.Untouchable: Gelen saldırıların belirtilen olasılıkla ıskalama (Miss) şansı vardır.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Instant Rupture: Doğrudan hasar verir; anlık etkiler 0 saniyelik süreye sahiptir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Görünmez olur ve rakip bir vuruşu ıskalayınca anlık rupture uygular. Savunma yeteneği azaltan şampiyon en iyi kontrol; vigilance veya vacilo-karşıtı şampiyonlar da işe yarar ama yine rupture alırlar.
signatureAbility:
From The Spotted Dimension
After a Portal Block ends, each hit of Ohnn's next successful Light, Heavy or Special Attack deals an Instant Rupture dealing [1,838.2 - 6,433.68] Physical Damage for each Spot gained during that Portal Block.
While Untouchable, Attacks that strike the opponent while they are performing a Heavy Attack or recovering from a Special Attack grant Ohnn a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [2,297.75 - 5,974.11] Attack Rating for 7 seconds.

abilitySections.title: When Struck - Spots - Max 10
content: Johnathon Ohnn's body is covered in portals to the Spotted Dimension, called Spots. Ohnn has a 20% chance when Struck to gain 1 Spot.
At 5+ Spots, being Struck by a Basic Attack grants Ohnn a 100% potency Untouchable Passive, causing incoming Attacks to have 100% chance to Miss for 5 seconds, paused during Ohnn's Special Attacks.
If Ohnn is struck while recovering from a Special Attack, 1 Spot is removed and cannot gain Spots for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: While
content: Ohnn becomes Stun Immune, cannot gain Spots, and consumes all Spots when Untouchable ends.
When an incoming attack would Miss, inflict a Rupture Debuff, dealing [5,974.15] Physical Damage over 0.5 seconds.
Landing a hit pauses Untouchable for 0.3 seconds and inflicts a non-stacking Infuriate Debuff, making the Opponent more aggressive and reducing their Offensive Ability Accuracy by 60% for 2 seconds.

Incoming Attacks from the Opponent and Attacks that make contact with Ohnn inflict a Rupture Debuff, dealing [2,297.75] Physical Damage over 10 seconds. This ability scales with Base Attack Rating only.

abilitySections.title: Portal Block - While Blocking
content: When Ohnn holds his block he gains a +[11,000] Block Proficiency bonus per Spot and then after 0.50 seconds he opens a portal to the Spotted Dimension in front of him. While Ohnn is Defending, Portal Blocks activate immediately. This ability is not affected by Ability Accuracy.
Portal Block grants the following effects for 2 seconds:
Ohnn is locked in place and gains 1 Spot when the Opponent strikes into the Portal Block. At 10 Spots Ohnn's Block Proficiency Bonus returns to 0.
+20% chance per Spot to resist Heavy Attacks and block Unblockable Attacks.
While Ohnn is affected by a Disorient effect, Portal Block does not trigger.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: After activation, gain 1 Spot per bar of Power spent.
At 10 Spots: Ohnn gains Untouchable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict a Buff Immunity Debuff on Ohnn for 10 seconds. At 10 Spots this lasts 20 seconds.
While active, each time Ohnn is immune to a Buff inflict a Rupture Debuff, dealing [2,297.75] Physical Damage over 10 second(s). This ability scales with Base Attack Rating only.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, if Ohnn is Untouchable, inflict a Physical Vulnerability Debuff, lowering Physical Resistance by [4,125] for 10 seconds. At 10 Spots this lasts 20 seconds.
Each hit deals a burst of [1,378.65] Physical Damage for each Rupture Effect inflicted on the Opponent since the start of the fight or Ohnn's last Special 2 Attack. Max: 50 stacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain Max Spots.
Once per fight if Spot is at 10 Spots increase the duration of all personal Rupture Effects by 100% for the rest of the fight.

abilitySections.title: Foul Play - Pre-Fight Ability
content: Ohnn starts each quest with 1 Persistent Charge, which can be spent in the Pre-Fight screen on the Foul Play ability.
Gain +1 Persistent Charge each time an Opponent is knocked out. Max charge(s): 3.
Foul Play: During the next fight, when the Opponent is knocked down Ohnn's Science teammate is inflicted with Buff Immune Debuff lasting 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - From The Spotted Dimension
content: After a Portal Block ends, each hit of Ohnn's next successful Light, Heavy or Special Attack deals an Instant Rupture dealing [1,838.2 - 6,433.68] Physical Damage for each Spot gained during that Portal Block.

While Untouchable, Attacks that strike the opponent while they are performing a Heavy Attack or recovering from a Special Attack grant Ohnn a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [2,297.75 - 5,974.11] Attack Rating for 7 seconds.
